test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate degree of comparison to fill in the blank.

The underground railway network, 'The Tube' in London is said to be ________ transport in London.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the most expensive**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**the most expensive**" is the superlative form of the adjective "**expensive**."
 
• The sentence compares the underground railway network (The Tube) to all other forms of transport in London, so the superlative degree is required.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The underground railway network, 'The Tube' in London is said to be **the most expensive**__ transport in London."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "expensive"** is incorrect because it is the positive degree and not suitable for comparison among all.
 
• **Option 3: "the expensive"** is incorrect because it is incomplete for a superlative comparison.
 
• **Option 4: "more expensive"** is incorrect because it is the comparative degree and not suitable for comparison among all.
